public.text: Governance is described as a cross-cutting property rather than a feature of a component. Later component descriptions nonetheless include detailed component-level governance requirements. These positions are compatible but the relationship is not made explicit.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that governance is cross-cutting at architecture level but must be instantiated through component-specific ownership, stewardship, access, lifecycle, and accountability arrangements.
